headline: Sir Patrick Stewart death certificate confirmed
post:

The document also notes that his remains underwent water cremation following his passing in Los Angeles. Tributes honoring the late Star Trek and X-Men star have been shared by friends and colleagues.

headline: Jessica Jones gets leopard print jungle costume
post:
Jessica Jones is trading the streets of New York for the prehistoric jungle. According to Screen Rant, Marvel has shared a first look at a leopard-print outfit for the cynical private eye in an upcoming comic series celebrating her twenty-fifth anniversary. Creator Brian Michael Bendis returns for Jessica Jones: Alias, launching this December to strand the hero in locations like the Savage Land, space, and Doctor Doom's Latveria. 🐅

Unlike her usual leather jacket and boots, this survival gear forces the urban investigator far away from her husband Luke Cage and their children. The story will also send her to crash New York crime boss meetings and face a brand-new client. Bendis explains that the journey lets him revisit cornerstones of the Marvel Universe while keeping the momentum firmly focused on who Jessica is today.

Are you excited to see Jessica explore the wider Marvel Universe? 

#JessicaJones #MarvelComics #SavageLand
original_title: Marvel Shares First Image of Jessica Jones 'Jungle Costume' For New Appearance

headline: Kevin Feige: Kang was always a red herring for Doom
post:
Before "Avengers: Doomsday" became our new reality, "Avengers: The Kang Dynasty" was supposed to set up Doctor Doom midway through the movie, according to Marvel's Kevin Feige speaking with Empire Magazine. Feige claimed that "The Doom of it all was well underway" before the legal issues involving Jonathan Majors. He also noted that changes to the project started after "Quantumania" was not received the way the studio would have liked. 

However, the timeline is tight, as "Quantumania" hit theaters in February 2023 and Majors was arrested the following month. Later that year, according to Variety, studio leadership discussed moving away from Kang at an annual retreat. We now know the pivot brought back the Russo brothers and Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom instead of Iron Man. 

Are you excited to see Doctor Doom take center stage in the MCU? 🎬

#AvengersDoomsday #KevinFeige #DoctorDoom
original_title: Avengers: The Kang Dynasty's Scrapped Doctor Doom Twist Explained By Marvel's Kevin Feige

post:
Former Major League Baseball pitcher and Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. actor Lance Broadway has passed away at the age of 43. Authorities found him on November 17 in a Dallas apartment complex stairwell.

The Dallas County Medical Examiner stated that his cause of death is still pending autopsy results.
